note: Single seed. Rows where fit_prior != eval_prior are out-of-prior: the model is being asked about a task family it was never fitted to. The calibration column is the point — an out-of-prior model that stays confident is worse than one that becomes uncertain.

tabpfn_reference.reason: TabPFN 8.2.0 gates its checkpoint behind interactive browser license acceptance, which cannot be completed non-interactively. No TabPFN number appears in this track.
tabpfn_reference.pretraining_advantage_note: TabPFN is a pre-trained checkpoint. It arrives having been fitted to a large synthetic prior at a compute cost that is not incurred by, or accounted for in, any baseline it is compared against here. A from-scratch model fitted on a few hundred rows is not its peer on equal terms, and any table containing both must state this. Neither the pre-training data nor its compute is measured by this repository.

cost.note: Single seed, CPU, on a shared machine — these are order-of-magnitude figures, not benchmarks. The PFN's prior fitting is a one-time cost paid before any of these datasets existed; each baseline's cost recurs per dataset.
